text: Raise a shout for יהוה, All the earth!
Serve יהוה with gladness; Come before His presence with singing.
Know that יהוה, He is Elohim; He has made us, and we are His — His people and the sheep of His pasture.
Enter into His gates with thanksgiving, And into His courts with praise. Give thanks to Him; bless His Name.
For יהוה is good; His loving-commitment is everlasting, And His truth, to all generations.
